fact: Airtel Madagascar, through Airtel Business, delivers enterprise satellite internet over the Eutelsat OneWeb low Earth orbit constellation in Madagascar, with installation, onboarding and technical support; the article gives no date other than its publication on 2026-06-01.
Starlink user-terminal broadband has been operational in Madagascar since 2023, according to Space in Africa (article of 2026-05-19).

TechnoMag lists Madagascar among countries where Starlink is active and names it a recent launch (as of mid-2026; article dated 2026-06-29, no event date given).
Le360 lists Madagascar among 29 African countries where Starlink has been granted a licence (article date used, none given for the grant).
Le360 lists Madagascar among the countries where Starlink is operational (article date used).
